# Empasy Docs (doc.empasy.com) — SyncSeries Technical Documentation Hub

> Official multilingual (KO / EN / JA) technical documentation portal for **Empasy SyncSeries** developed by **Empasy Inc. (주식회사 엠파시)** — covering enterprise AI test automation (`SyncETA`), multi-agent orchestration (`SyncVerse`), core back-office (`SyncBoot`), multilingual SSR CMS (`SyncCMS`), and 7 modular enterprise extensions.

## Flagship Focus: SyncETA (씽크이티에이) — AI Test Automation & Self-Healing QA Platform (Desktop v0.0.66)
SyncETA is a Korean enterprise **AI test automation platform** combining no-code browser action recording, Excel/CSV and one-line natural-language scenario conversion, **Vision-LLM + DOM context selector Self-Healing**, **Visual Regression** layout/text-overlap auditing, and **zero-LLM-cost deterministic Playwright MCP replay**—runnable locally via Windows/macOS desktop apps or on-premise in air-gapped networks.
